name: Linda Mar Shopping Center

Anchored by Safeway, this well-maintained property serves an affluent coastal community with a variety of everyday retail, fitness, dining, and service tenants.
demographics: Linda Mar Shopping Center serves a highly affluent coastal community with a 1-mile radius average household income of $190,281 and median household income of $148,253. The trade area population of approximately 6,718 residents within 1 mile expands to over 500,000 within 10 miles, drawing from the broader San Francisco-Oakland-Berkeley metro area. description: Linda Mar Shopping Center is a 168,231 square foot grocery-anchored community center strategically located directly off Highway 1 in Pacifica, California, serving the affluent coastal communities of the San Francisco Bay Area. Anchored by Safeway, this well-established shopping destination has become an essential part of the Pacifica community, offering residents convenient access to everyday retail, fitness facilities, dining options, and essential services all in one location. The center's prime location along the scenic Pacific Coast Highway makes it easily accessible to both local residents and visitors exploring the beautiful California coastline. With a diverse tenant mix designed to meet the daily needs of the surrounding community, Linda Mar Shopping Center combines the convenience of neighborhood shopping with the quality retailers that the affluent local demographic expects. The property is professionally managed by Kimco Realty, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, ensuring high standards of maintenance and tenant services.
